title: Tesla expands robotaxi service to San Antonio
summary: TechCrunch 报道 Tesla 于 11 月 9 日宣布在圣安东尼奥提供 robotaxi 服务，文章同时指出车队规模、运行时段与是否配安全员等关键条件尚未披露。
investorNote: 城市覆盖扩大不等于无人驾驶规模化，运营数据和安全员配置才决定可比性。

evidence.quote: Tesla is expanding its robotaxi service to another Texas city as it seeks to compete with Waymo and position itself as more than just an automaker. The company said in a post on X that it will make its robotaxis available in San Antonio starting at 5 a.m. local time on Monday.

Tesla didn’t provide any additional details about the service, such as the hours of operation, whether the fleet will offer customers its gold, two-seater Cybercab as well as its modified Model Y vehicles, or if these vehicles will have human safety monitors on board. displayTitle: Tesla 将 robotaxi 服务扩至圣安东尼奥
narrative: 据 TechCrunch，Tesla 把 robotaxi 服务扩至圣安东尼奥，并称当地时间周一清晨开始提供服务。不过报道时，公司尚未交代车队规模、运营时段以及车内是否有安全员。新增一个城市说明网络继续铺开，但不能据此计算真正无人驾驶的供给能力；比较 Tesla 与 Waymo 时，须先对齐服务区域、车辆数和人工监护口径。

eventRelation.reason: 11 月 9 日新增城市服务，与历史 Waymo 车队合作无关。
